findings.title: CISA, NSA, FBI joint advisory AA24-038A on Volt Typhoon pre-positioning in US critical infrastructure
findings.summary_md: The February 7, 2024 advisory warned that PRC-sponsored Volt Typhoon actors were compromising US critical infrastructure networks using living-off-the-land techniques. It covered communications, energy, transportation, and water sectors, including Guam, and described pre-positioning for potential disruption during a future crisis. This is earlier public government attribution of the group the Silent Train framework later replaced.

findings.title: US disrupts China-linked KV-Botnet used by Volt Typhoon to conceal critical infrastructure intrusions
findings.summary_md: On January 31, 2024, officials announced a December 2023 FBI-led disruption of the KV-Botnet that Volt Typhoon used to mask attacks on US critical infrastructure. The operation, paired with public warnings, removed a staging layer the group later rebuilt as Silent Train after the takedown reduced bot counts to roughly 650 by mid-January 2024.
